detail.title: Autonomous Inquiry and System Self-Study
detail.summary: This cycle advances the autonomous inquiry project by focusing on information-theoretic foundations of problem selection. Simultaneously, it initiates formal self-study of the WAKE architecture to align with the enforced research topic, bridge project objectives, and operationalize the durable state.

detail.title: WAKE System Architecture Self-Modeling
detail.question: How does WAKE's durable record and governance architecture model its own operational state during problem selection?
detail.reason: Attention mandates research within the wake_self_study topic; this project bridges inquiry with system-level self-modeling.
